newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle bid $109/dressed, passed-trade.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle bid $109/dressed, passed-trade.

text.p: Nebraska feedlot cattle bids were light at $108.00 to $109.00 per cwt on a dressed basis and passed by owners asking $110.00, market sources said.
Most of this week's cattle sales were at $109.00 on Wednesday, with a few at $109.50 to $110.00 late Thursday, the sources said.

Sales this week were not large enough to clean out showlists, which will result in a carryover of supplies next week, they said. As of Friday, weekly volume was pegged at 46,500 head, USDA statistics showed. The weekly showlist had been estimated near 80,000 earlier in the week.
